clauses.title: The PR Skill lets a repository's own template govern the body's sections
requires: Where the target repository has a pull-request template of its own — a template file GitHub applies, such as `.github/pull_request_template.md`, or a template its `CONTRIBUTING.md` or `AGENTS.md` requires — that template governs the body's sections instead of the three parts above; the rules below still apply wherever the template leaves the wording to the author, and a body's section layout alone is never a finding (CL-D95).

clauses.title: CL-D95 records the precedence and what it leaves unchanged
clauses.section: ## CL-D95 — A repository's own pull-request template governs the body's sections
requires: Recording per repository which body contract applies is deferred
CL-D67's per-head rule, the exact-autofix grant, and every gate's authority are unchanged

clauses.title: The CL-D95 fixtures pin the sentence and the record
Every gate reads that a body's layout alone is never a finding
requires: A pull-request body's section layout alone is never a finding; its claims are judged for accuracy against the head (CL-D95).

clauses.title: CL-D85 names the narrowing
clauses.section: ## CL-D85 — Wording-only Minors do not stop a run
requires: CL-D95 later let a repository's own pull-request template govern the body's sections, so the three parts named here apply where the repository has none.

clauses.title: CL-D67 names the narrowing
clauses.section: ## CL-D67 — Pull-request bodies carry no per-head facts
requires: CL-D95 later let a repository's own pull-request template govern the sections in place of the three parts, keeping the rules on per-head facts and chronology.
